scenario.description: A small software development team is tasked with implementing a new user authentication module for an existing web application. The module needs to be secure and efficient. The team consists of a Lead Developer, a Backend Engineer, and a Frontend Engineer. The Lead Developer oversees the overall architecture and guides the team. The Backend Engineer is responsible for the server-side logic and database interactions. The Frontend Engineer handles the user interface and client-side interactions. A critical, non-negotiable constraint is that the API endpoint for user login must respond within exactly 250.00 milliseconds to ensure a smooth user experience, and all password hashes must use the Argon2id algorithm. The fully connected topology ensures every agent can directly communicate with any other agent instantaneously, which is essential for maintaining situational awareness and adhering to precise technical and time-bound constraints. This is an easy structural-complexity task, with an expected 10 turns, requiring robust information exchange to ensure both the performance and security constraints are consistently applied. The agents will have ample opportunity to share and reinforce the constraints.
